a: Editing a sequence with a locked part throws, even though its regions still accept presses
Dragging a head into or out of a box leaves the box drawn around a non-member
On a theme that isn't 12px sans-serif, a new sequence's lifeline misses the click
Dragging a message or fragment leaves its number digit or type label behind
An activation still open at a destroy runs past the cross to the diagram's foot
`SEQ_ARROWS` lookups go through the prototype chain
`setMessageArrow` treats an explicit `both: false` or `async: false` as a change
b: Any sequence edit throws when one of the root's parts is locked, though `redrawSequences` skips such a sequence
A step drag's preview leaves the number badge's digit, the fragment's type label, and the fragment's own rows behind
A Participant click on empty canvas places the new lifeline using the default 12px font, while the sequence is drawn in the theme's font
Open activations on a destroyed lifeline are closed at the diagram's foot, so the bar runs past the destruction's cross
`SEQ_ARROWS` is read through the prototype chain and without a guard, so an unexpected arrow name gives a message with no line or head, or throws
